observations: AGENTS §2.4 on the board: Q124 has R126 220 ohm series, R128 10k gate pull-down, R127 1k at PE4, C126 220 nF G-S; Q122 has R122 1k, R123 2k, C123 10 nF; Q120/Q121 have R121 10k series, R119 || R120 = 50k G-S, C120 1 uF G-S (pcbnew pad nets). Pinouts AON7524 1-3 S / 4 G / 5 D, AONR21357 1-3 S / 4 G / 5-9 D, AO3400A 1 G / 2 S / 3 D, D120 BAT54A anode on 3V3, cathode on PYRO1_COLD: all consistent.
AGENTS §2.2: RAW_ACT is fed only from Q121's drain behind Q120 (drain on BAT_IN); already ruled (R10_DECISIONS:1034, round 21 / 32 lenses).

Adjacency audit (own script, every foreign copper item within 0.6 mm of PYRO1_*, ARM1_*, ACT_*, RAW_ACT, BAT_ENABLE, BAT_SW_*, 1.2 mm for the gate nets, PYRO1_OUT and the EN chain, all four layers, fills included): 100 pairs; every §1 / owner row 1 / row 2 figure reproduces. PYRO1_OUT to 3V3 1.050 mm / 3V3A 1.040 mm; gate nets to the 3V3 via 1.0585 / 1.065 mm; PYRO1_GATE to 3V3A 1.145 mm; ARM1_SENSE-CAM_IO_3V3 0.150 mm; RAW_ACT-USB_LIMITED 0.225 mm; BAT_ENABLE to BAT_IN / BAT_FAULT_N 0.200 mm, to RAW_ACT 0.500 mm, to ACT_EN 0.330 mm: match the records.

In2 3V3 to RAW_PROTECTED / PORT_5V3 fills 0.300 mm and to the J440.1 / J9.1 In2 rings 0.2506 mm reproduce owner row 1. In2 3V3 to the USB_LIMITED track is 0.2505 mm (USB 5 V onto 3V3, only with USB attached, which the procedure excludes with an e-match).

Repeats of ruled classes, not new: rule 4's 0.93-1.01x envelope (R27-MCU obs 5); Q124.4-Q124.5 gate-to-drain 0.520 mm (round 25 / 29 triage); ACT_EN_MCU run to LS120.2 BUZZ_OUT 0.520 mm (row 2 PC1 enable-chain class); U9.1-U9.2 BAT_OVLO 0.200 mm (EN about 0.57 V at 8.4 V, cannot turn on); PYRO1_OUT-BUZZ_G 0.510 mm.

Single faults that energise the bus with J400 open (Q122 short, ACT_GATE / ACT_DRV to GND, Q121 short, Q121 gate-to-drain) are the disclosed row 2 class, screened by per-flight step 2 (J121.2 < 0.1 V); none fires without Q124 conducting, since Q124's gate is held by R128 / R127 with the MCU unpowered.

Single faults that turn the board on with J400 open (EN leaks to BAT_IN, BAT_FAULT_N, RAW_ACT, ACT_EN; the J400.2 harness cases; an open EN via to R81) are all listed in §1 / per-flight step 2; recomputed thresholds 1.52-1.83, 0.58, 1.69-1.96, 0.29 MOhm and the 2.88 / 1.87 / 1.28 V harness EN values reproduce.

Rules 3 and 4 agree word for word across the binding note, M3_R10 Firmware, ORDERING 8.3 and FMEA I-2 / H-2; recomputed 0.91 kOhm (1k || 10.22k), 3.23 V (3.3 x 10/10.22), cold CONT 0.0994 / 0.146 V and bridged 0.295 V, 0.54 V for CONT_MID-3V3, unclamped ESD 5.45 + 2.03 = 7.5 V.
AGENTS pyro row's '1.279 A (conditional)' and STATUS:180's '1.279 A ... (Calculation)': the first was ruled labelled by the round 29 triage sweep; the second is the dated round 19 history entry.

Per-flight steps 2-4 are executable on the intact circuit: J121.2 bias with J400 open is Q121 IDSS x 11.2k (tens of mV at most), bus off within 1 s of opening J400 (EN tau 66 ms, gate tau 50 ms), meter paths across the match are >= 11 kOhm.
